import json, os, subprocess, sys
from pathlib import Path
base=Path(__file__).parent
root=base/"native-no-llm-init1"
root.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
env=dict(os.environ)
for name in list(env):
    if name in ("PYTHONPATH","PYTHONHOME") or any(x in name.upper() for x in ("OPENAI","ANTHROPIC","LLM","GEMINI","COHERE")):
        env.pop(name)
env.update(DATA_DIR=str(root),DATABASE_URL="sqlite+aiosqlite:///"+(root/"data/pulse.db").as_posix(),KG_BASE_DIR=str(root),UPLOAD_DIR=str(root/"uploads"),METRICS_DIR=str(root/"metrics"),KG_EMBEDDING_MODE="stub",KG_EMBEDDING_DIM="384",KG_GRAPH_BACKEND="grafx",KG_GLOBAL_GRAPH_BACKEND="grafx",OKTO_PULSE_SKIP_DEMO_SEED="1",OKTO_PULSE_TERMS_ACCEPTED="1",OKTO_PULSE_NO_BANNER="1",HF_HUB_OFFLINE="1",TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE="1",PYTHONUTF8="1")
result=subprocess.run([str(base/"venv/Scripts/okto-pulse.exe"),"init","--bootstrap-key-handoff",str(root/"bootstrap-key")],env=env,cwd=root,capture_output=True,text=True,encoding="utf-8",timeout=300)
keypath=root/"bootstrap-key"
key=keypath.read_text().strip() if keypath.exists() else ""
output=result.stdout+result.stderr
assert not key or key not in output
(root/"init.log").write_text(output,encoding="utf-8")
print(json.dumps({"exit_code":result.returncode,"credential_handoff":bool(key),"root":str(root)}))
print(output[-6000:])
sys.exit(result.returncode)

import asyncio,json,logging
logger=logging.getLogger("okto_pulse.services.kg_health")
logger.setLevel(logging.DEBUG)
logger.addHandler(logging.StreamHandler())
from pathlib import Path
from sqlalchemy import select
from okto_pulse.core import configure_settings
from okto_pulse.community.config import CommunitySettings
from okto_pulse.community.cli import _configure_community_relational_runtime
from okto_pulse.community.adapters.sqlalchemy_database import get_session_factory,close_db
from okto_pulse.community.adapters.sqlalchemy_models import Board
from okto_pulse.community.adapters.composition import configure_community_kg_registry
from okto_pulse.community.adapters.coordination import register_community_coordination_providers
from okto_pulse.community.adapters.kg_shutdown import close_all_graphs_on_shutdown
from okto_pulse.core.services.kg_health_service import get_kg_health
async def main():
    settings=CommunitySettings()
    configure_settings(settings)
    _configure_community_relational_runtime(settings)
    factory=get_session_factory()
    register_community_coordination_providers()
    configure_community_kg_registry(factory,settings=settings)
    try:
        async with factory() as db:
            board=(await db.execute(select(Board))).scalars().one()
            assert not (board.settings or {}).get("cognitive_llm_config")
            from okto_pulse.core.kg.interfaces import get_kg_registry
            cypher=get_kg_registry().cypher_executor
            try:
                result=await asyncio.to_thread(cypher.execute_read_only,board.id,"MATCH (n:Spec) RETURN n.relevance_score",{},max_rows=10000)
                print("direct_probe",result)
            except Exception as exc:
                print("direct_probe_error",type(exc).__name__,str(exc))
            from okto_pulse.core.services import kg_health_service as service
            original=service._read_health_query_group
            def observed(*args,**kwargs):
                results=original(*args,**kwargs)
                for result in results:
                    if isinstance(result,Exception):
                        print("query_failure",type(result).__name__,getattr(result,"code",None),getattr(result,"details",None),repr(result.__cause__))
                return results
            service._read_health_query_group=observed
            health=await get_kg_health(board.id,db)
            observations=[health]
            for attempt in range(6):
                if not any(v.get("refresh_in_progress") for v in health["probe_diagnostics"].values() if isinstance(v,dict)):
                    break
                await asyncio.sleep(2)
                health=await get_kg_health(board.id,db)
                observations.append(health)
            Path(settings.data_dir,"health-observations.json").write_text(json.dumps(observations,indent=2,default=str),encoding="utf-8")
            Path(settings.data_dir,"health.json").write_text(json.dumps(health,indent=2,default=str),encoding="utf-8")
            print(json.dumps(health,default=str))
    finally:
        await asyncio.to_thread(close_all_graphs_on_shutdown)
        await close_db()
asyncio.run(main())
